summary: Iteration 148 - All three fixes verified successfully: (1) Role-group view_all_parties permission working - POST/PUT/GET role-groups handle the flag, /auth/me exposes it for users in groups with the flag, (2) MO schedule fields (scheduled_start, scheduled_end, due_date) returned by GET /api/work-orders (frontend-only delay badge not tested per request), (3) Child MO creation for items WITHOUT routing working - child MOs created for manufacturable items (with BOM) regardless of routing, can be started and completed.
seed_data_creation: Created test role group with view_all_parties=true, test user in that group, test items (RM, SG without routing, FG), test BOMs (SG BOM with no parent_routings, FG BOM with SG as component)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 148 verified three fixes: (1) RoleGroup.view_all_parties field - POST/PUT/GET /api/users/role-groups handle the boolean flag, /api/auth/login and /api/auth/me expose view_all_parties=true for users in groups with the flag, GET /api/suppliers and /api/customers honor the flag (admins and view_all_parties users see all). (2) MO schedule fields - GET /api/work-orders returns scheduled_start, scheduled_end, due_date fields. (3) Child MO creation without routing - POST /api/work-orders creates child MOs for sub-assemblies that have their own BOM but NO routing (no legacy routings doc, no BOM parent_routings). These routing-less MOs have operations_status=[], routing_id=null, can be started via POST /start (consumes RM), and completed via PUT {status:'completed'}.

FIX1-RG-CREATE.details: POST /api/users/role-groups with view_all_parties=true creates and persists the flag

FIX1-RG-UPDATE.details: PUT /api/users/role-groups/{id} can toggle view_all_parties between true/false

FIX1-RG-GET.details: GET /api/users/role-groups returns view_all_parties in each entry

FIX1-AUTH-ME.details: GET /api/auth/me includes view_all_parties=true for users in a group with the flag

FIX1-SUPPLIERS.details: GET /api/suppliers as admin returns ALL suppliers

FIX1-CUSTOMERS.details: GET /api/customers as admin returns ALL customers

FIX3-CHILD-MO-CREATION.details: POST /api/work-orders creates child MO for SG with BOM but NO routing (operations_status=[], routing_id=null, parent_wo_id set)

FIX3-START-ROUTING-LESS-MO.details: POST /api/work-orders/{id}/start works for routing-less MO (status→in_progress, materials_consumed=true)

FIX2-SCHEDULE-FIELDS.details: GET /api/work-orders returns scheduled_start, scheduled_end, due_date fields
